verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents publicly available RESTful APIs and a CRM holding deals, activities, and conversations, so an agent could plausibly pull pre-meeting account data. There is no MCP server, no documented endpoints for deals, emails, or history, and no account-brief feature. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt on the API docs site all returned 404. missing for 10: official MCP server, documented endpoints covering open deals, emails, and activity history, a machine-readable API spec, an agent-generated account brief or meeting-prep capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Access to publicly available RESTful APIs
Manage contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, activities, and conversations in one place.
API and integration support for extended workflows
